entities.name: Clinic Management System
entities.description: A hybrid-cloud platform designed for medium-sized hospitals and clinics to manage patient admissions, electronic medical records (EMR), scheduling, and billing while ensuring high availability, strict regulatory compliance, and high-performance clinical workflows.

entities.name: Patients
entities.description: Individuals receiving care who interact with the system for scheduling and portals via web or mobile clients.

entities.name: Receptionists/Admins
entities.description: Administrative staff managing patient admissions, front-desk workflows, and scheduling.

entities.name: Clinicians/Doctors
entities.description: Medical professionals managing electronic medical records (EMR), clinical workflows, and patient care.

entities.name: Billing Specialists
entities.description: Staff members handling financial records, invoicing, and insurance claims.

entities.name: Compliance/Security Officers
entities.description: Personnel responsible for monitoring audit trails, security, and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, GDPR).

entities.name: Hospital/Clinic Management
entities.description: Executives viewing management dashboards and high-level clinical operations data.

entities.name: External Identity Provider (IdP)
entities.description: External system providing authentication services via OpenID Connect (OIDC) / SAML 2.0 with MFA.

entities.name: External Lab & Imaging Systems
entities.description: External diagnostic systems exchanging medical imaging and lab data via HL7 FHIR.

entities.name: Insurance Clearinghouse
entities.description: External system receiving insurance and billing claims via EDI over secure SFTP / HTTPS.
